messages:
tariq: quick postmortem follow-up — we surfaced three remediation streams after the GPU surge: quota uplift, scheduler tuning, and a headroom runbook. need owners + pragmatic timelines. i can kick off the tracker and weekly sync.

maya: i can own scheduler tuning. plan: 2w for a first-pass tuning + perf tests, then iterate. will pair with infra. :point_up:

anita: i'll handle quota uplift (vendor + cloud quota requests). need to loop in finance/legal for spend headroom. aiming to have outreach done in 5 business days.

sam: i'll draft the headroom runbook (what to do in surge, temporary backstops, automated fallback). suggest 10-day draft so we can validate in next sim. recommend include runbook hooks for canary rollbacks.

tariq: awesome. i'm creating a tracking doc and a weekly 30-min sync (fridays 10am PT). tracker link: https://docs.google.com/example (placeholder). action summary below — please confirm owners/dates.

```
- QUOTA-UPLIFT: owner=anita, due=+7d, milestones=[vendor outreach, quota approv, apply limits]
- SCHEDULER-TUNING: owner=maya, due=+14d, milestones=[perf baseline, tunables PR, validate 50% load]
- HEADROOM-RUNBOOK: owner=sam, due=+10d, milestones=[draft runbook, tabletop dry-run, embed automation hooks]
- METRICS/ALERTS: owner=tariq, due=+5d, milestones=[headroom dashboard, surge alert thresholds]
```

maya: quick Q on scheduler tunables — do we prefer conservative defaults first? i.e., reduce batch sizes + lower preemption threshold. example config snippet i want to test: 

```yaml
kube-scheduler-config:
  max-gpus-per-node: 1
  preemption-threshold: 0.2
  scale-down-delay: 60s
```

anita: noted — i'll start vendor + cloud support threads today and attach response timelines in the tracker. tagging finance for any quota cost approvals.

infra-bot: current cluster headroom: 8% (gpus free), 95th p95 token-latency increased during surge. saving metrics to /incidents/gpu-surge/metrics-2062345678.csv

sam: for the runbook draft, i'll include three phases: immediate fallbacks (disable low-priority routes), mid-term ramp (reserve burst pool), long-term (capacity commit + scheduling improvements). will upload draft to the tracker by EOD +10.

opsbot: created task INC-8421 and calendar event "GPU Remediation Weekly" (Fridays 10:00 PT). reminder set for owners 24h before sync.

maya: ack. i'll post the first perf baseline results in the tracker by day 5. :white_check_mark:

anita: ack, starting quota tickets now.

tariq: thanks all. if anyone blocks on permissions/resources, call me out here or DM. we'll run the first tabletop in two weeks during the sync and validate the runbook ops steps.

sam: SGTM, will prepare tabletop checklist.

maya: +1

anita: +1 :thumbsup:
